requirements_summary: Enterprise finance customer; strict data residency (US-only), regulatory retention, and heavy audit/KMS requirements. Wants private VPC deployment with customer-managed KMS keys, per-request encryption and full key rotation policy. Must support mTLS in-transit; want proof of cert lifecycle and automated rotation. Audit logging to SIEM (Splunk) with tamper-evidence and 1+ year retention. Secrets must be centrally managed (HashiCorp Vault or AWS Secrets Manager). Pen test and SOC2/ISO artifacts required before final signoff.
notes:
CRM notes (fragments, call quotes) - encryption posture focus:
- 'We cannot accept provider-managed keys for sensitive PII and transaction logs' (Acadia SecOps)
- Primary ask: Private VPC deployment w/ customer KMS (bring-your-own-key). Confirmed Redwood supports KMS integration and CMKs via API/Cloud HSM.
- In-transit: require mutual TLS (mTLS) for all inbound and east-west service traffic. Need documentation: cert issuance, rotation cadence, revocation procedure.
- At-rest: all data at rest encrypted with CMK; DB snapshots encrypted; backups stored in region (US-East/US-West selectable).
- Key rotation: must support scheduled rotation with zero-downtime key rollover and key versioning for decryption of historical data; rotation audit trail required.
- Secrets management: prefer HashiCorp Vault integration. Alternatives acceptable: AWS Secrets Manager or Azure KeyVault with equivalent access controls.
- Audit logging: forward application and access logs to customer SIEM; need schema for log types (authz/authn, key usage, admin ops). Retention policy: 1-3 years depending on log type.
- Data residency: entire control plane and data plane in US-only regions; data residency attestation required.
- Compliance artifacts requested: SOC2 Type II report, recent pen-test summary, ISO27001 (if available), encryption architecture diagram.
- POC notes: ran sample docs and chat in VPC POC; latency good, KV cache working. Need to validate log forwarding and cert rotation in next POC phase.
- Pricing sensitivity: enterprise commit but wants clarification on encryption-related add-ons (HSM costs, network egress, extra logs retention).
- Next meeting: legal + SecOps on 2026-03-08 to close outstanding KMS contract language.
- Quick links: INF-3421 (request for architecture diagram), SEC-2107 (security questionnaire follow-up).
